about: KUMAKIKAI plans, develops and operates apps for iPhone and iPad. Taking notes in class, reading a conversation that is hard to hear, keeping track of benefit codes: we build useful tools around specific moments in everyday life.

Our products span learning, communication support, and everyday records and organisation. We distribute them primarily through the App Store and continue to review and improve their features and usability after release.
founderBio: Yuya Nakamura has experience in software development across embedded systems, business systems and mobile apps. At KUMAKIKAI, Yuya currently plans, develops and operates apps for iPhone and iPad.

Development starts with tools Yuya would want to use personally. For Uni:Note, advice from current students also informs the app’s development. The focus is on making tools easy to use for the people who need them, with improvements continuing after release.
buildTitle: For everyday moments in learning and life.
buildIntro: We currently publish and operate %d products on the App Store. These selected apps introduce the areas we work in.

areas.title: Learning and notes
areas.description: Writing in class, organising materials and reviewing them later. We develop apps that support learning on iPad and iPhone.

areas.title: Communication support
areas.description: We work on apps that help people communicate, including captions for words that are difficult to hear.

areas.title: Everyday records and organisation
areas.description: We build tools that reduce everyday effort, from managing benefit codes and expiry dates to keeping records and browsing information.

principles.title: Make essential tasks clear
principles.description: We consider how screens and interactions can help people get to what they need, rather than adding features for their own sake.

principles.title: Start with the situation
principles.description: We choose features with real situations in mind, such as opening an app during class, in conversation or on the move.

principles.title: Keep improving after release
principles.description: We continue to improve published apps by fixing issues and reviewing how they work in everyday use.

mediaText: We welcome enquiries about coverage, interviews, our products and potential collaborations. Official introductions to our apps are available under Press Release.
contactText: Please email us with your publication, the nature of your enquiry, the relevant product and your preferred timing, where applicable. For app instructions or issues, please see the support section on each Product page.
